persons.name: Padmākalisimha
persons.evidence: रिषितेयं (i.e. लिखि०) काय-वाहारया श्रीवजवाक्ष्य पद्या- कलिासंहिन

notes: The manuscript text is described by Bendall as extremely corrupt ('barbarously incorrect character of the MS'). 'रिषितेयं' stands for likhiteyam; 'श्रीवजवाक्ष्य' likely stands for śrī-vajrācārya; 'पद्या- कलिासंहिन' appears to be an error for Padmākarasiṃha or Padmākalīsiṃha; 'काय-वाहारया' indicates the vihāra of the scribe (possibly Kwa Bahāl / Kāya-bahāla).
